Title: Retirement: Azure Cache for Redis is retiring on September 30, 2028.

Body.Content:
Azure Cache for Redis (Basic, Standard and Premium) will be retired on September 30, 2028. We recommend you migrate your workloads to use Azure Managed Redis before September 30, 2028. Azure Cache for Redis instances that are not migrated by September 30, 2028 will be shut down.  
Learn more.
